author: Kushal
problem: signups is the text of a carpool sign-up sheet: riders' names separated by commas, like 'Ana,Ben,Cho'. People sometimes sign up twice, with different capitals or spacing. Return how many different riders signed up.
bug_description: Splits the text without checking for an empty sheet, and ''.split(',') gives [''], so an empty sheet counts one rider.

comments.accurate: Counts the different riders on the sheet, ignoring case and spaces
comments.wrong_behavior: Counts the different comma-separated entries on the sheet, ignoring case and spaces
comments.wrong_location: Splitting checked; names with a middle space like 'Ana Li' may be counted twice
